name: stt-app
description: Transcribes audio files with speaker diarization
author: Lulu Hever <lulu.berlin.2023@gmail.com>

scripts.typecheck: tsc -p tsconfig.json --noEmit && tsc -p tsconfig.renderer.json --noEmit && tsc -p tsconfig.scripts.json
scripts.dist: pnpm run build && node stage.ts && electron-builder --config electron-builder.yml --linux deb --x64
scripts.dist:mac: pnpm run build && node stage.ts && electron-builder --config electron-builder.yml --mac dmg --arm64
scripts.dist:win: pnpm run build && node stage.ts && electron-builder --config electron-builder.yml --win zip msi --x64
scripts.test: prettier --check . && pnpm run typecheck && tsc -p tsconfig.test.json && node --test src/backend.test.ts
